title: Weapons and Armor
summary: Weapons and armor included shields, swords, helmets, spears, breastplates, and belts used in battle imagery.
background: Scripture uses literal battle equipment and spiritual metaphors. Understanding armor helps clarify David and Goliath, prophetic images, and Ephesians 6.
teachingHelp: Explain the literal equipment first, then show how the passage uses it spiritually where appropriate.
